en: Ba Thory opened his mouth wide and{n}wiggled his tongue like an anglerfish's lure.{n}Seeing it, the bug crawled as if drawn{n}into the bug tamer's mouth. His throat{n}swelled comically, the swelling moved{n}from chest to belly, and at last it was{n}wholly absorbed into Ba Thory's body.

jp: うげぇ……

jp: 大きくよろめいた瞬間、バ・ソリーは{n}岬から足を踏み外して湖に転落した。{page}と、にわかに湖面が波打ち、そして{n}水底から黒い影が浮上してくるや、{n}それは巨大な怪魚の顎となって、疑似{n}餌よろしく湖面でもがくバ・ソリーを{n}丸飲みに連れ去った。それほどまでの{n}大きさであった。
en: Staggering wildly, Ba Thory stepped off{n}the cape and tumbled into the lake.{page}All at once the surface heaved, a black{n}shadow rose from the depths, and it{n}became the jaws of a giant monster fish{n}that swallowed Ba Thory whole and bore{n}him away, as he struggled on the water{n}like so much bait. That was how huge{n}it was.

jp: ただ、だーずーげーでーゴボボ……
